project_type: Academic research project - Jupyter notebooks + Word proposal document
build_system: None - individual Jupyter notebooks and Python scripts
test_framework: None - validation is done by running notebook cells and checking docx output
build_command: python -c "import nbformat; nb = nbformat.read('NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb', as_version=4); print('Notebook valid')"
test_command: python -c "from docx import Document; doc = Document('AflahZakISiregar_103062300095_PenulisanProposal-Final-AI-V8.docx'); print(f'Doc valid: {len(doc.paragraphs)} paragraphs, {len(doc.tables)} tables')"
verification_instructions: 1. Validate notebook JSON is parseable. 2. Check that cell 10 has NaN cleanup code after SMOTE-ENN. 3. Validate docx opens correctly and tables have correct content.
setup_instructions: pyenv global 3.12.13 && pip install nbformat pandas python-docx
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. pyenv with python 3.12.13. python-docx and nbformat installed.
key_patterns: Notebook uses nbformat for programmatic editing. Docx uses python-docx Document API. Existing table structure in docx must be preserved.
directory_structure: Flat repo structure - notebooks, docx files, CSV datasets, PDFs all in root directory. No src/ or tests/ directories.
